command: set -euo pipefail; export RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE=m19m21; export ROOT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/m21-t0150-evidence"; rm -rf "$ROOT"; mkdir -p "$ROOT"; node scripts/test-services.mjs reset --namespace m19m21 > "$ROOT/reset.log"; for i in $(seq 1 10); do ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test -Dtest=ModelFailoverIntegrationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false > "$ROOT/targeted-$i.log" 2>&1; grep -q 'tests="17" errors="0" skipped="0" failures="0"' apps/worker/target/surefire-reports/TEST-com.riccon.worker.model.ModelFailoverIntegrationTest.xml; echo "targeted_run=$i tests=17 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0"; done; rm -rf apps/*/target/surefire-reports platform/*/target/surefire-reports; ./mvnw -q -T1C -pl apps/worker -am test > "$ROOT/worker-full.log" 2>&1; node scripts/test-timings.mjs --out-dir "$ROOT/test-timings" > "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; grep -q "apps/worker: tests=356 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0" "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; grep "apps/worker: tests=" "$ROOT/test-timings.out"; echo "evidence-ok targeted=10x17 worker_full=356/0/0/0"
